Title: NETMESSAGE:Scrub: Ouch! If you want to get past my brothers down below, remember this code:\nTwenty-three is number one!
Translation: 小家伙：哎哟！如果你想通过下面我的兄弟们，记住这个代码：\n23是第一名！

Title: NETMESSAGE:You got a Pink Fairy !\nThis will respawn one dead player.
Translation: 你获得了一只粉色的妖精！\n这将复活一名死去的玩家。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Kill Deku Scrubs with Deku Nuts\nor the Slingshot!
Translation: 用德库坚果或弹弓\n杀死德库矮子！

Title: NETMESSAGE:This web on the floor is strong.\nIt's going to take at least two people\nto break it.
Translation: 地板上的蛛网很坚固。\n至少需要两个人\n才能打破它。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Webs blocking our path can burned down.\nIs there anything we can ignite this with?
Translation: 挡住我们的蛛网可以烧毁。\n我们有什么东西可以点燃它吗？

Title: NETMESSAGE:These scrubs must be killed in order.\nRemember the clue you got earlier?\nTwenty-three is number one !
Translation: 这些矮子必须按顺序杀死。\n还记得你之前得到的线索吗？\n23是第一名！

Title: NETMESSAGE:The torch in this room burned out.\nTry lighting it with a Deku Stick!
Translation: 这个房间的火把熄灭了。\n尝试用德库棒点燃它！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Big Skulltulas can't be hurt from the front.\nGet someone to distract it while you attack!
Translation: 大蜘蛛从正面无法伤害。\n让一个人吸引它的注意力，你攻击！

Title: NETMESSAGE:This wall can be broken only with explosives.\nHave any Deku nuts with you?
Translation: 这堵墙只能用炸药破坏。\n你身上有德库坚果吗？
